added.titleZh: 每月给母亲寄 3,000 美元，回家却发现她在赊米
added.title: Millionaire Sent His Mom $3,000 a Month—Came Home Unannounced, Found Her Begging for Rice on Credit
added.whyZh: 回家撞见母亲赊米，把一桩家庭秘密压进一个能立刻看懂的反差。YouTube 原帖标注 Made with AI。
added.whyEn: A son finds his mother buying rice on credit despite the money he sends. The contrast sets up the family mystery. The source is labelled Made with AI.

added.whyEn: The wedding is followed by abandonment at a Chicago train station, giving the protagonist a clear reversal from the start. The source is labelled Made with AI.
